_note: What may be reached at what depth. Under the stack every area owns a whole plane to itself, so there is no 'beside' any more — a coven can never share a wall with a town, structurally, whatever a table said. What is left is a fence on when an archetype may be reached at all, which is what actually kept the coven a find rather than a trip-over.

depthGate._note: Rungs from the Hub, not tiers. An archetype outside its band is never rolled there at all, which is how a coven stays a thing you find rather than a thing you trip over.
